properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 3 at 5:55AM EDT until August 3 at 9:00AM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
properties.description:
FFWBOX

The National Weather Service in Norton has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Hartford County in northern Connecticut...
Northwestern Tolland County in northern Connecticut...
Hampden County in western Massachusetts...
Southeastern Hampshire County in western Massachusetts...

* Until 900 AM EDT.

* At 555 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain across the
warned area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have fallen. The
expected rainfall rate is 1 to 2 inches in 1 hour. Additional
rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are possible in the warned area.
Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban
areas, highways, streets and underpasses as well as
other poor drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Springfield, Hartford, New Britain, West Hartford, Bristol,
Manchester, Chicopee, East Hartford, Enfield, Southington,
Westfield, Holyoke, Glastonbury, Newington, Vernon, Windsor,
Agawam, West Springfield, Wethersfield and South Windsor.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued August 3 at 8:21AM EDT until August 3 at 9:45AM EDT by NWS Mount Holly NJ
properties.description:
SMWPHI

The National Weather Service in Mount Holly NJ has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Delaware Bay...
Coastal waters from Cape May NJ to Cape Henlopen DE out 20 nm...

* Until 945 AM EDT.

* At 820 AM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located over Slaughter

Fortesque Beach, Brown Shoal Light, Fourteen Foot Bank Light,

Point, Miah Maull Light, Brandywine Shoal Light, and Cross Ledge

properties.instruction:

open water, stay below deck if possible and keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 2 at 8:24PM CDT until August 6 at 1:00PM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Nueces River Near Three Rivers affecting Live Oak County.

Nueces River Near Tilden affecting McMullen County.

For the Nueces River...including Cotulla, Tilden, Three Rivers,
Mathis, Bluntzer, Calallen...Major flooding is forecast.

- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage late
Thursday morning and continue falling to 16.0 feet Friday
evening.
- Flood stage is 25.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 38.1
feet on 06/24/1981.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Even 6 inches of fast-moving flood water can knock you off your feet
and a depth of 2 feet will float your car. Never try to walk, swim,
or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/crp.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 3 at 7:02AM EDT until August 3 at 10:00AM EDT by NWS Mount Holly NJ
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Portions of New Jersey, including the following counties,
Burlington, Camden, Gloucester, Mercer, Middlesex and Somerset and
southeast Pennsylvania, including the following counties, Bucks,
Delaware, Montgomery and Philadelphia.

* WHEN...Until 1000 AM EDT.

* IMPACTS...It will take several hours for all the water from these
storms to work through local drainage systems in urban areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 658 AM EDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges
indicated heavy rain due to thunderstorms. Flooding is
already occurring in the warned area with several lane
closures across portions of Burlington and Camden counties.
Between 0.5 and 3 inches of rain have fallen.
- Flooding impacts will continue, but no additional rainfall is
expected.
- Some locations that may experience flooding include...
Philadelphia, Trenton, Camden, Gloucester City, Bensalem,
South Brunswick, Ewing, West Deptford, Princeton, Bellmawr,
Yeadon and Woodbury.
- This includes the following highways...
Interstate 295 in New Jersey between mile markers 20 and
25...and
between mile markers 60 and 76.
Interstate 76 in Pennsylvania between mile markers 335 and
351.
Interstate 195 in New Jersey near mile marker 0.
Interstate 95 in Pennsylvania between mile markers 13 and 40.
Interstate 676 in Pennsylvania between mile markers 0 and 1.
Interstate 676 in New Jersey between mile markers 0 and 4.
Interstate 76 in New Jersey between mile markers 1 and 3.
Pennsylvania Turnpike between mile markers 341 and 359.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
